name: Rocket no Natsu
source:
There used to be a season called "Rocket summer"...
The Earth has become a member of the Galactic Federation and has accepted multiple emissaries from aliens.  Silver rockets are launched from the Earth on daily basis, but one day all inter-galaxy contacts cease and space port doors get shut. 

Main character has dreamed of space travel since childhood. One day he decides to help girl Chise to participate in self-made rocket competition "50 Miles Over". Together with princess from the other star they form a rocket club. Will their dreams come true? 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-october-2002-rocket-no-natsu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
曾經有一個被稱為「火箭之夏」的季節……
地球已經加入銀河聯邦，並接納了多位外星使節。銀色火箭每天從地球升空，然而某一天，所有星際聯絡突然中斷，宇宙港的大門也隨之封閉。

主角從小夢想著前往太空。一天，他決定幫助少女千星參加名為「50 Miles Over」的自制火箭大賽。隨後，他們與來自異星的公主共同成立火箭社。夢想能夠成真嗎？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-october-2002-rocket-no-natsu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
